description: Native fetchhub-4 transactions included in blocks for today or yesterday UTC. Returns successful/failed/total counts, success percentage and average TPS over contiguous finalized 15-minute buckets. Empty periods with valid coverage have zero TPS and a NOT_APPLICABLE/null success percentage. Missing evidence returns an error, never zero activity. Not peak TPS, capacity, messages, or mempool attempts. Signature status is explicit in integrity.signed; no statistical anomaly or security verdict. Default: today.
name: fet112.transaction_activity
title: Native Fetch Transactions and Success
